question: What compensation is required when items beginning with the stated offering are omitted?
premises: An omission of items beginning with the stated offering occurs
The compensation may be double or only that substance
inference: One should give that substance in double quantity or give only that substance as compensation.
uncertainties: Exact scope of yādyādi depends on ritual context
plain_english: One should give that substance in double amount, or alternatively give only that substance.
